hypotheses.statement: Yellow taxi trips on Thursday 2024-11-28 dropped significantly compared to the average of the three prior Thursdays in November 2024 (2024-11-07, 2024-11-14, 2024-11-21).
hypotheses.support_if: Target day trips are >15% below baseline average.
hypotheses.refute_if: Target day trips are within ±5% of baseline average.

hypotheses.statement: Thanksgiving Day (2024-11-28) is a federal holiday that suppresses commuter and business travel, causing a large trip count drop versus regular Thursdays.
hypotheses.support_if: us_holidays confirms 2024-11-28 is a national holiday (Thanksgiving) and baseline Thursdays are not holidays.
hypotheses.refute_if: 2024-11-28 is not flagged as a holiday or baseline days are also holidays.

hypotheses.statement: Adverse weather (precipitation, snow, or extreme cold) on 2024-11-28 reduced demand relative to the prior Thursdays.
hypotheses.support_if: 2024-11-28 shows measurable prcp_mm/snow_mm or tmax_c well below baseline Thursdays' averages.
hypotheses.refute_if: Weather on 2024-11-28 is similar to or better than baseline Thursdays.

hypotheses.statement: The drop is an artifact of missing or incomplete trip data for 2024-11-28 (e.g., partial day load, vendor outage).
hypotheses.support_if: Trip count is implausibly low (e.g., near zero) or avg_total_amount/avg_trip_distance are null/outlier vs. baseline.
hypotheses.refute_if: All metrics for 2024-11-28 are present and within plausible ranges.

hypotheses.statement: A shift in fare mix (e.g., fewer short/high-volume trips, more long/low-volume trips) on the holiday makes the trip count drop look larger than the underlying demand change.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_trip_distance on 2024-11-28 is materially higher than baseline while avg_total_amount per mile is lower, indicating mix shift.
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount on 2024-11-28 are in line with baseline Thursdays.

hypotheses.statement: Trip origins/destinations shifted away from high-density zones (e.g., Manhattan core) on the holiday, reducing total trip volume even if per-zone demand was stable.
hypotheses.support_if: Not directly testable with daily aggregates; would require zone-level data. Kept as a placeholder for future drill-down.

plan.rationale: Thanksgiving is a known major holiday; the primary hypothesis is holiday suppression (H1). Weather (H2) and data quality (H3) are standard alternative explanations. Baseline uses the three prior Thursdays in November for a like-for-like weekday comparison.

answer.headline: Thanksgiving holiday drove 45.5% trip drop; weather and data quality ruled out
answer.answer: Yellow taxi trips on Thursday 28 Nov 2024 fell 45.5% versus the mean of the three prior Thursdays in November 2024 (77,244 trips vs. baseline average of 141,642). The drop coincides with Thanksgiving, a federal holiday confirmed by us_holidays. Weather on 28 Nov (21.8 mm rain, 9.4 °C) was not the primary driver: a baseline Thursday with heavier rain (39.9 mm on 21 Nov) showed normal trip volumes (153,149). Data on 28 Nov is complete with no nulls or outliers. Average trip distance rose sharply (from ~4.3 km baseline to 9.47 km) while average fare decreased (from ~28.6 USD to 25.3 USD), indicating a shift toward longer but cheaper rides, likely airport flat-fares. Zone-level analysis was not possible due to aggregated data only.
answer.recommendation: Attribute the trip drop primarily to Thanksgiving holiday effects; monitor future holiday Thursdays for similar magnitude drops. Investigate airport trip share if raw trip-level data becomes available to test the fare mix shift hypothesis. Do not attribute the drop to weather or data quality issues.
